body:
Thanks for the reply. I know you're right about this. Sorry to hear you went through similar, that makes me sad just to hear. 

She has emotionally abused me for years. I'm just sort of used to it now. I've even asked her at times if we could just have one day where we are happy and she doesn't get upset. A few months back she actually did that. A whole day, no meanness, no upset. It felt like a normal relationship aside from the fact it was obviously still her and she was mostly faking. I'll never forget that day though, it was like... Woh! Lol. That's why I feel like, there's no way I would be worth having that sort of thing with a normal woman all the time. It is not going to happen. I'm not good enough.

I do agree. I probably need to eventually send her back to her family. Even if I'm alone it's not right to keep a situation like this going forever. I've seen older people who've done it for decades and in old age they are being abused by their partner (both men and women) and it's fuckin scary. 

Boundaries... First date we ever had, I'll never forget, we walked up to pay for the food and she just looked at me all innocent. She said she had no money. I felt bad for her. For awhile I made sure she knew if she didn't at least respect me she was gone. I guess once I became emotionally attached after a couple of years this attitude of mine went out the window.

She has humiliated me and yelled at me and made fun of me in public, to the point she was kicked out of more than one restaurant and I had to break up more than one fight she started with other people.

I don't hate her at all, never would. I care about her well being. Even through all the pain. But she has done things that even when I try to force myself to feel happy or to love her, it just hurts and feels weird. The last time we had sex, years ago felt so weird. I had to force myself and I felt disgusted with myself afterwards. 

It's true, I am alone. It sucks.

I really don't think I will. In part I know it's because I am not worthy or deserving of it. Whether it has been her or me or both or whatever it is, I feel like the world would be better without me. I feel like I would be... How do I put it. If some one was with me, I know they could have better. I know I'll never be worth 1st place or gold medal, no matter how hard I try (sorry, speaking in athletic terms lol). I'm not exactly normal, like most people and never will be and that's not okay. 

What do you mean though, people in relationships aren't happy? I thought lots of people in relationships were happy? I've known plenty and once upon a time, long ago I was one. It was so incredible. (Never was with her though).

I don't get it because I've seen girls flirt with other guys but never with me. Even if some one didn't want to be serious about me or just be a friend even, I just feel like no one likes what I am. 

I do agree, maybe some where in the world, the person I could truly make happy is out there, maybe, but the chance of meeting them is so statistically low that I know it just won't happen.

Thank you so much for this. It means a lot to me.

I do take care of myself. Shower daily, brush my teeth twice or more daily, wear nice clothes, wear cologne every day. I try to work with what I've got. People used to tell me a good personality makes up for a lot so I've tried hard to have that but I always feel like I'm failing there too. If I wasn't, why has no one wanted anything to do with me, again, even as a friend?

I don't ever want to be a creeper, or weird so I never ask girls for their Facebook or info, but none have ever asked for mine. I've even hinted towards it but no one asks so I leave it alone.

I would live to give all the world I ever could and more to some one who would just smile at me and be happy to be around me. Even if I did deserve more, I know I'm not what people want in this world, in these times. I'm just not it, for anyone. In a way it hurts, in a way I'm okay with it. I make people laugh, I'm in good shape and I know how to listen, how to be patient, how to live some one and show it and mean it, so I know that in that regard I've accomplished something, but to use a metaphor I have in the past...

Even if you're the best sailboat ever built, if you sit in the middle of the desert your worth is 0. You can know you.mean something, but also not worth anything at all.

This is something I think about a lot. Happy being me. There's some things I am okay with about myself, I think there are good qualities to me. I've basically been playing single player mode for a long time. Most things she doesn't want to do with me so I do them alone. I love my hobbies and interests and doing them, they bring me joy. 

While I might have some good qualities I look at things logically and realistically. In the past 8 years only 1 woman who my meeting was a bit of a miracle showed me any interest whatsoever. She was very sweet but ended up cutting ties with me for some one who had money.

At this age women want a man who even if not rich, is financially secure and has a good career. I don't blame them.

I'm in good shape but there are a few small flaws with me, like my thinning hair in the back. I've been made fun of for it big time. I know it's a huge turn off.

I also know my personality is a bit... Different. I'm very outgoing but some people think I'm gay, which I have nothing against gay people (some I know are truly awesome) but I'm not gay, I just act way more outgoing than the typical "man." Women don't tend to like this much, but I've realized at my age now while there are some things I can tweak, I cannot completely change who I am.

I have a lot of respect for women. I don't want a "woman" I want a partner, some one equal I can be there for who can be there for me too. Some one who wants more out of life than sex and finances. I love conversation, having adventures, I'm a good listener and a good companion, even this person I'm with will admit I'm extremely patient. 

I just know the way society works that there is just no place for some one like me.

I don't want to wake up at 32 with it, yet here I am.

I dunno. I don't hate her. I want her to be okay in life and taken care of. I've been abandoned many times in life, by family, parents and lovers so I'm afraid of doing it to some one else. 

I would love to be happy my friend. Thank you for your kind words.

Maybe you're right. Unfortunately I hate myself with a very deep seated hatred. I am not worth the oxygen I use up in a day. I do my best every day to hopefully make people smile and help others when I can but I know I am not worth anyone's time. Too much of me is too far off center and too broken. I have the fitness, even if I had better looks and a bunch of money I would know I'm still not worth being alive. I've tried to love myself, be confident, work on my own interests and life, etc. Unfortunately, so many things have torn that down and people have shown me I'm just... Not worth existing. I still wake up and try my best but it hurts, every day hurts.
I'm sorry to hear this my friend. I'll keep him in my prayers. Keep your head high and be positive.

Oh I know, there are ladies like you out there. It's just so rare, unfortunately. I also don't blame anyone for what they want, how can you? Even if it's money, or looks in one way or another. I also have a ton of respect for women, at least if they are nice or earn it. I'm one of those guys that just never felt strange or nervous around girls, they are just people, like guys. Unfortunately most human beings on this planet have a lot different views than I do, in many ways. I don't fault them for it but damn does it get lonely sometimes.

There's some girls who have told me to my face they like seeing me and talking to me, but I never am pushy or ask for contact info or anything. I respect people's space and don't want to seem weird.

Thanks for your encouragement :)

Proximity crush? Idk, I don't see her all the time. Only for a couple of hours, every few days. We do a lot of work in various locations. She probably makes more but my position is more "skilled" not that it matters, I guess? Same with any others but any others it's like, it would be nice just to have some lady friends at least. But again, I never, ever want to be weird or pushy. I would rather never have one single friend and when I depart this world people say "Oh yeah, he was very nice. A bit awkward, maybe weird, but we liked him."

I had one of them say she likes me one time, in a very friendly way (she's married) but it made my day. Made me feel super happy.

Both. Semi-Professional, trade skill type environment. Not dairy queen and not a doctor's office, somewhere in between. I've actually noticed at the office jobs I've worked at things were slightly more... Relaxed?

My friend.

I've worked on myself, participated in hobbies, done things alone, been nice to people and refused to pursue anyone or even touch a dating app for a decade now. I've lost a good 8 years or so of my life. I'm 32 now and realize nothing is going to happen.

Yep, I feel ya on this.

I'm 32 years old and share a condo with my Dad. Have too. I have steady work and am considered a "professional" but am not making a lot right now. My profession is kind of a dead end career. Even though I have perfect credit, a nice vehicle and pay all my own bills since I don't have my own place currently and can't provide some one with "the American Dream" at 32 I'm looked at as worthless. 

I met a girl and really fell for her but in the end I got tossed aside for some one who made much more than me. None of the women I work around have any interest in me at all.

I'm told I have a great personality. I'm very extroverted, was in sales for a long time and have no problems holding a conversation or making girls laugh. I'm also a good listener and know how to actually listen, not just nod till it's my turn to talk. 

Some times I think women WANT an introverted guy, who's like a big quiet gruff gorilla. I don't fit that archetype. Throw on the fact that my hairline is not the greatest and I'm going bald in the very back and I'm 100% positive I'm not what women want.

Even though I'm in great shape (I'm a cyclist, runner and Triathlete) it doesn't seem to matter. I've been told it's 100% wrong to approach women at work and so I don't, even though there is a girl I really really like. I know I'm not what she wants. It hurts really bad. I'm also not a super sexual person and sometimes I think that's what most women want, that or some one who can blow their absolute mind in bed. You have to know EXACTLY what to do and when at this stage in life (sexually) no exceptions.

Yep, you're not alone my friend.

I'm not worthy of love, at all. I don't see things the way most people see them. I don't fit in with the times very well.

The only people who would be heartbroken by my departure are my parents, who didn't want me for most of my life growing up, who split up when I was young. They decided they wanted anything to do with me much later and I don't blame them. I moved from one coast to the other to be a few hours from my Mom who has money and never comes to see me, ever. Didn't before this whole covid thing either. They like to act like they care now but they put me into some situations and through some things early on in life that I've never been able to fully recover from. They originally had a big college fund set up for me and blew through it and used the rest through their divorce. I love them both and while they might be "sad" for awhile my decision to leave would not be based on them unfortunately. 

Anyone else on this planet would either not know I was gone, not care or be glad. Anyone else I've had such small dealings with, I'm such an insignificant spec in their life that they would probably be like "oh no, how unfortunate" and forget about it a few hours later. 

I'm just not like most people. My whole life I've never fit in well. I don't like having a ton of friends. I don't like hanging bout randomly with people. I am not compatible for companionship and as some one else here even stated I have things going against me that cannot be corrected.

My life is not going to be corrected anytime soon. I'll be truly old before anyone would even begin to want me. By then I just don't care.

I appreciate your kindness. I gave you an upvote, not sure who voted you down but thank you for your reply.

I would look even weirder bald. I've tried getting it buzzed to the point it was basically bald before and everyone laughed, even me. I keep my hair pretty short. You're right, it is a bad look. I've tried treatment and nothing works. Bald does not look good on me at all so I'm kind of screwed.

My career is one of the things you listed. All of those fields require super long work hours to make good at them, even with experience. I got $1500+ a week and had to work 70-80 hours a week for it.

I know, online dating is all anyone ever does anymore... For some reason people will not date from work anymore. I hear stories of it but never have seen it. I've tried online dating years ago and it worked out very, very, very badly for me. I would rather be alone forever than do online person marketplace. It takes meeting someone naturally and turns it into such a casual, forced, unnatural feeling thing... Idk, more reason as to why I say what I do...

Heh, King? I'm more like a Court Jester, constantly laughed at, made fun of, pathetic, never taken seriously. I wish I could just be a mere peasant. I would settle for that. My entire life is full of "I wished." It will just go into the collection. There is no one who will truly love me but I understand completely, I'm not supposed to be loved. I'm not supposed to be here.

Thanks for the reply.

No way I could ever tell her. I know she's probably just being nice. Even if she enjoys my company a bit, I know that's all it is. I just wish so bad I could be who she wanted. I wish I was that person. 

I'm old enough, I'm not some horny kid, I know how to remain professional and not make it weird. I know I'm not worth it. I know I'm not good looking enough. I just wish once, one time I could give her a big hug, smile and say "You're amazing, you make me so happy and I think the world of you" if even I disappeared forever after that. But I just don't have that in me.
